title: The actual cases (verify everything yourself)
what: The most recent court cases our search matched, with the text snippet that triggered the match and a link to the full record on CourtListener.
how: These are the raw rows behind the litigation charts above - no processing beyond the search itself. Company names appearing as plaintiffs/defendants here also feed the 'revealed clients' analysis in the R&D section.
thesis: Transparency: any number on this page can be traced back to a court record you can open and read. If a match looks wrong, you can see exactly why it matched.
caveats: A case mentioning Exponent near expert language does not say WHICH side hired the firm unless the text itself says so.
Snippets are short excerpts chosen by the search engine, not summaries of the case.
